summary: Check-In feature testing complete. All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Check-In page loads with summary cards (104 total, 40 students, 5 staff, 59 cadre), category tabs filter correctly, search works, detail sheet opens with all 4 steps (arrival, paperwork, room_assignment, gear_issue), Check-All and Undo-All functionality works correctly.

issues: Minor: Console warning about <span> inside <tbody> - React hydration warning, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' - This is a React hydration warning likely from the Emergent preview wrapper, not a code issue
seed_data_creation: Using existing data: 104 participants (40 students, 5 staff, 59 cadre). One student (Ayers, Tasean) has 'arrival' step already checked in.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Check-In feature fully implemented and tested. The 4 steps are: arrival, paperwork, room_assignment, gear_issue. Support cadre roles (support_logistics, support_comms, support_pa, support_dining, support_health) are defined with correct permissions. support_logistics has check_in_view=True and check_in_edit=True. support_health has health_view=True.
